## 📊 WEEK OVERALL
- **Total complaints tracked:** 32
- **Most responsive:** MTC Chennai — ≈67%, same-day, substantive escalation language
- **Least responsive:** CMRL, CUMTA, KSRTC Kerala — all 0%
- **Top complaint category:** delays — service delay/frequency (~7) plus project/station-works delay (~6) ≈ 13 of 32
- **Response-time observations:** MTC same-day (hours); Chennai One same-day; DTC ~under an hour on one captured thread (ID proximity); BMTC docket same/next day; BEST & DTC generic forwards same-day

## 🏆 Best Response
**DTC Delhi** — the red-light-jumping reply named concrete action: 2-day refresher course at Nand Nagri Training School for the driver, penalty on the concessionaire, and a counselling directive to all unit drivers. Rare public action-taken detail; the Karala–Begumpur route-deviation reply was similarly candid. (MTC remains the steadiest acknowledger; BMTC's dockets the most trackable.)

## ⚠️ Needs Improvement
**CMRL** — third straight week at 0% while Phase-2 delay questions pile up unanswered. **BEST** — repeat complainant on Route 252 (2 posts, bus idle at depot) met with silence or generic forwards; an injury-risk infra report (exposed steel, Andheri West) deserves more than "forwarded".

## 📌 Open Issues
- ❌ **CMRL Phase-2 Poonamallee–Vadapalani opening** — CRS clearance reportedly 7 months ago, no public timeline, multiple unanswered complainants
- ❌ **DTC senior-citizen AC pass** — stuck since Sep 8: no link, portal down, phones unanswered, refund requested
- ❌ **BEST Route 252 scheduled trips not operated** — bus idle at depot, driver resting; repeat, unanswered
